1.1: Chattat haof naaset lematta, vechattat behema lemala. olat haof naaset lemala, veolat habbehema lematta. im shinna baze uvaze, pasul. seder kinnim kach hu. hachova, echad chattat veechad ola. bindarim unedavot, kullan olot. ezehu neder, haomer hare alay ola. veezo hi nedava, haomer hare zo ola. ma ben nedarim lindavot. ella shehannedarim, metu o nignevu, chayyavim beacharayutam. unedavot, metu o nignevu, en chayyavim beacharayutan:
1.2: Chattat shennitarva veola veola vechattat, afillu echad beribbo, yamutu chullam. chattat shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella cheminyan chattaot shebbachova. vechen ola shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella cheminyan olot shebbachova, ben shehachova merubba vehannedava memuetet, ben shehannedava merubba vehachova memuetet, ben sheshshetehen shavot:
1.3: Bamme devarim amurim, bechova uvindava. aval bechova shennitarva zo vazo, achat lazo veachat lazo, shetayim lazo ushetayim lazo, shalosh lazo veshalosh lazo, mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. achat lazo ushetayim lazo, veshalosh lazo, veeser lazo, umea lazo, hammuat kasher, ben mishshem echad, ben mishshene shemot, ben meishsha achat, ben mishshete nashim:
1.4: Ketzad mishshem echad, leda veleda, ziva veziva, mishshem echad. mishshene shemot, leda veziva. ketzad shete nashim, al zo leda veal zo leda, al zo ziva veal zo ziva, mishshem echad. mishshene shemot, al zo leda veal zo ziva. rabbi yose omer, shete nashim shellakchu kinnehen beeruv, o shennatnu deme kinnehen lakkohen, leezo sheyyirtze chohen yakriv chattat, uleezo sheyyirtze chohen yakriv ola, ben mishshem echad, ben mishshene shemot:

2.1: Ken setuma shepparach mimmenna gozal laavir, o shepparach ben hammetot, o shemmet achad mehen, yikkach zug lashsheni. parach leven hakkerevot, pasul ufosel echad kenegdo, shehaggozal happoreach, pasul ufosel echad kenegdo:
2.2: Ketzad. shete nashim, lazo shete kinnim velazo shete kinnim, parach mizzo lazo, posel echad bahalichato. chazar, posel echad bachazirato. parach vechazar, parach vechazar, lo hifsid kelum, sheafillu hen meoravot, en pachot mishshetayim:
2.3: Lazo achat, lazo shetayim, lazo shalosh, lazo arba, lazo chamesh, lazo shesh, lazo sheva. parach min harishona lashsheniyya, lashshelishit, larviit, lachamishit, lashshishshit, lashsheviit, chazar, posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato. harishona vehashsheniyya en lahem kelum, hashshelishit yesh lah achat, harviit yesh lah shetayim, hachamishit yesh lah shalosh, hashshishshit yesh lah arba, hashsheviit yesh lah shesh. parach vechazar, posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato. hashshelishit veharviit en lahem kelum, hachamishit yesh lah achat, hashshishshit yesh lah shetayim, hashsheviit yesh lah chamesh. parach vechazar, posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato, hachamishit vehashshishshit en lahem kelum, hashsheviit yesh lah arba. veyesh omrim, hashsheviit lo hifsida chelum. veim parach mibben hammetot lechullam, hare chullam yamutu:
2.4: Ken setuma veken meforeshet, parach min hassetuma lamforeshet, yikkach zug lashsheni. chazar, o shepparach min hameforeshet rishon, hare chullan yamutu:
2.5: Chattat mikkan veola mikkan usetuma vaemtza, parach min haemtza latztzedadin, echad helach veechad helach, lo hifsid kelum, ella yomar, ze shehalach etzel chattaot, chattat. veze shehalach etzel olot, ola. chazar laemtza, haemtzaiyyim yamutu, ellu yikrevu chattaot, veellu yikrevu olot. chazar o shepparach min haemtza latztzedadin, hare chullan yamutu. en meviin torin keneged bene yona, velo vene yona keneged torin. ketzad. haishsha shehevia chattatah tor, veolatah ben yona, tichpol vetavi olatah tor. olatah tor, vechattatah ben yona, tichpol vetavi olatah ben yona. ben azzay omer, holchin achar harishon. haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta, yaviu hayyorshin olatah. olatah umeta, lo yaviu hayyorshin chattatah:

3.1: Bamme devarim amurim, bechohen nimlach. aval bechohen sheeno nimlach, achat lazo veachat lazo, shetayim lazo ushetayim lazo, shalosh lazo veshalosh lazo, asa chullan lemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyam lemala vechetzyam lematta, et shellemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul, veet shellematta, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul:
3.2: Achat lazo, ushetayim lazo, veshalosh lazo, veeser lazo, umea lazo, asa chullan lemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyan lemalan vechetzyan lemattan, hamerubbe chasher. ze hakkelal, kol makom sheatta yachol lachalok et hakkinnin velo yehu mishshel ishsha achat, ben milmalan ben millemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kol makom sheen atta yachol lachalok et hakkinnin ad sheyyehu mishshel ishsha achat, ben milmalan ben millemattan, hamerubbe chasher:
3.3: Chattat lazo, veola lazo, asa chullan lemalan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyan lemalan vechetzyan lemattan, shetehen pasul, sheani omer, chattat kereva lemalan veola lemattan:
3.4: Chattat veola usetuma umeforeshet, asa chullan lemalan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lematta, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyan lemalan vechetzyan lemattan, en kasher ella setuma, vehi mitchalleket benehen:
3.5: Chattat shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella minyan chattat shebbachova. chova shenayim bechattat, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. vechattat shenayim bechova, hamminyan shebbachova kasher. vechen ola shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella minyan olot shebbachova. chova shenayim beola, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. ola shenayim bechova, hamminyan shebbachova kasher:
3.6: Haishsha sheamra, hare alay ken kesheeled zachar, yalda zachar, mevia shete kinnim, achat lenidrah veachat lechovatah. netanatam lakkohen, vehakkohen tzarich laasot shalosh peridim milmalan veachat millemattan. lo asa chen, ella asa shetayim lemalan ushetayim lemattan velo nimlach, tzericha lehavi od perida achat, veyakrivenna lemalan, mimmin echad. mishshene minin, tavi shetayim. persha nidrah, tzericha lehavi od shalosh peridim, mimmin echad. mishshene minin, tavi arba. kava nidrah, tzericha lehavi od chamesh peridim, mimmin echad. mishshene minin, tavi shesh. netanatam lakkohen veen yadua ma natna, halach hakkohen veasa veen yadua me asa, tzericha lehavi od arba peridim lenidrah, ushetayim lechovatah, vechattat echat. ben azzay omer, shete chattaot. amar rabbi yehoshua, ze hu sheamru, keshehu chay kolo echad, ucheshehu met kolo shiva. ketzad kolo shiva. shete karnav, shete chatzotzrot. shete shokav, shene chalilin. oro, letof. meav, linvalim. bene meav, lechinnorot. veyesh omrim, af tzamro litchelet. rabbi shimon ben akashya omer, zikne am haaretz, kol zeman shemmazkinin, datan mittarefet alehen, shenneemar (iyyov 12), mesir safa leneemanim vetaam zekenim yikkach. aval zikne tora enan chen, ella chol zeman shemmazkinin, datan mityashshevet alehen, shenneemar (sham), bishishim chachma veorech yamim tevuna:
